subject: Reserve hardware priority & rate pivot request — OrbitAI
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sasha Liu <sasha@orbitai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Reserve hardware priority & rate pivot request — OrbitAI

Hi team,

Quick context: OrbitAI is moving toward a Dedicated commit (12-month) and just returned a signed term sheet (attached). Their immediate ask is non-standard: they need an H200 priority assignment for their first 6-week onramp (because their model latency profile degrades on older variants), plus a short reservation grace window while their infra handoff completes. Specifically: 

- Hardware priority: H200 (not H100) for dedicated pool assignment for the first 6 weeks.
- Reservation grace: a 90-day temporary reservation hold (they want to defer strict reservation activation while they finish validation).
- Overage/rates: request a blended overage pivot: 15% below our standard overage rate for the first 90 days, with a one-time burst credit of $200k to cover abnormal onboarding spikes.

Why this matters: OrbitAI is a fast-scaling analytics platform; they forecast 3x committed usage by month 4 and signed an ARR commitment that should make this a strategic account. They will commit to the Dedicated term immediately once we confirm hardware and short-term rate terms. 

Can Deal Desk confirm whether we can approve this on a one-off basis, and if so what approvals we need (legal amendment, finance memo, exec signoff etc.)? I attached the signed term sheet and their May usage export for reference.

Thanks,
Marcus
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: OrbitAI_signed_term_sheet_20270528.pdf, OrbitAI_monthly_usage_May2027.csv

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sasha Liu <sasha@orbitai.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserve hardware priority & rate pivot request — OrbitAI

Marcus — thanks for the note and the attachments. Quick clarifying questions before we escalate to ops/finance: 

1) During the 6-week H200 priority window, are they willing to accept preemption (i.e., we provide H200 but with preemption allowed if capacity constraints arise)? If not, that materially increases operational risk and cost.
2) Are the projected 3x usage figures in the term sheet tied to milestone-based commit increases, or is that a soft forecast? If milestone-based, we can structure staged reservations.
3) The blended overage pivot (15% off) + $200k burst credit is material. We will need an exec confirmation for the hardware preference + rate concession. Finance will want an illustration of unit economics.

I can draft the approval memo once we have answers — suggest looping in Aditya for exec cover. Sasha, quick confirmation on preemption tolerance?

—Lauren
Deal Desk Lead, Redwood Inference

---

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Liu <sasha@orbitai.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: OrbitAI — recommendation for hardware & rate pivot

Team — I reviewed the attached usage and forecast. Recommendation and rationale below: 

Recommendation (one-time approvals):
- Approve H200 assignment for the initial 6-week onboarding window, with the following constraint: preemption tolerated for non-critical batch jobs; guarantee for interactive inference lanes only.
- Approve a 90-day reservation grace (effectively delaying strict reservation enforcement until 2027-08-31) so OrbitAI can complete perf validation and infra cutover.
- Approve a 15% discount on standard overage rates for the 90-day window.
- Approve a one-time $200k burst credit to offset onboarding token costs; credits applied against the first two invoices.

Business rationale: OrbitAI is committing to a 12-month Dedicated term with significant growth signals. Short-term concession reduces churn risk and accelerates onboarding; hardware preference mitigates model regressions that would otherwise force them to pause launch. Expected net revenue (after concession) remains attractive given projected volumetric ramp and cross-sell opportunity.

Dependencies and conditions:
- Legal to issue a short SOW amendment and DocuSign for the 90-day grace and credit application.
- Finance to confirm invoicing mechanics for blended overage and credit application.
- Ops to tag H200 assignment and monitor interactivity KPIs; if usage exceeds forecast by >40% in month 1, we reserve the right to re-evaluate.

If this reads OK I recommend Vanessa sign the exec approval.

—Aditya
VP, Sales Operations

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Liu <sasha@orbitai.com>, Procurement <procurement@orbitai.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Escalation: OrbitAI — recommendation for hardware & rate pivot

Thanks team — after reviewing the memo and attachments I approve the one-time concessions as outlined by Aditya with the following explicit conditions: 

1) Hardware priority: H200 assignment approved for up to 6 weeks starting on the activation date. Ops to provision with the interactive inference lanes flagged as non-preemptible; batch lanes may be preemptible.
2) Reservation grace: 90-day hold approved; reservation activation cutoff = 2027-08-31. After that date, normal reservation accounting applies.
3) Overage & credits: 15% off standard overage rate for the 90-day window; one-time $200k burst credit applied across first two invoices. Finance to confirm billing lines and show a sample invoice.
4) Monitoring & exit: Ops to provide weekly usage snapshots during the grace window. If usage exceeds forecast by >40% in any rolling 7-day, Deal Desk reserves right to suspend the discount and revert to standard overage for the next billing period.

Legal: please draft the SOW amendment reflecting the grace window and credit. Finance: please produce a sample invoice and confirm cash application for credits. Ops: tag the reservation and monitor. Lauren/Marcus/Karthik — pls coordinate the customer comms once legal + finance are ready.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

---

Notes: OrbitAI confirmed verbally that preemption is acceptable for batch lanes; Sasha will route DocuSign to legal/procurement once the SOW amendment is received.
